newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Three killed in Bosnia mine explosions -- NATO.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Bosnia mine explosions -- NATO.

text.p: Three Bosnians were killed and several injured in two mine explosions, international officials said on Monday.

Two members of a de-mining team died and two were wounded on Sunday when one of them stepped on a mine in the northeastern town of Gradacac near a former front line, said Andrea Angeli, spokesman for the U.N. police monitoring force.

In a separate incident, a tractor struck a mine about 15 km (10 miles) from Gradacac, killing one civilian and injuring five others, Major Simon Haselock, a spokesman for the NATO-led peace force (IFOR), told reporters.
"IFOR troops assisted in the removal of the victims from both of the mine strikes," Haselock said.
"These incidents are an obvious and tragic reminder that there are far too many mines...some tens of thousands...that pollute this country and continue to maim and kill innocent civilians."
Bosnia is littered with mines left over from a 3-1/2 year war that ended last autumn.
